tool_definitions.description:
Creates an allocation of funds from a funding source from one OU in the application to another.


**Request Body:**

Fields to create an allocation. (Required)


**Request Properties:**

- **allocate_all_available_funds**: Whether all available funds should be allocated to the OU. If this is true, then amount will be ignored.

- **amount**: Amount of money being allocated from one OU to another.

- **comments**: Comments about the allocation.

- **from_ou_id** (Required): The ID of the OU the money will be coming from.

- **funding_source_id** (Required): The ID of the funding source where the money originally came from.

- **to_ou_id** (Required): The ID of the OU the money will be going to.

You can use this tool to allocate funding source funds from a parent ou to a child ou. THIS IS AN IMPORTANT FINANCIAL OPERATION! ALWAYS ask the user for explicit permission before using this tool.
tool_definitions.name: allocate_funds

tool_definitions.description:
Creates a budget in the application.


**Request Body:**

Structure for creating a budget.


**Request Properties:**

- **amount**: Total amount for the budget. This is required if data is not specified.
Budget entries are created between start_datecode and end_datecode (exclusive)
with the amount evenly distributed across the months.

- **data**: Month to month budget amounts. If not specified, these values are generated based on
amount, start_datecode, end_datecode, and funding_source_ids.

- **end_datecode** (Required): Year and month the budget ends. This is an exclusive date.

- **funding_source_ids**: Optional funding source IDs to use when data is not specified.
This value is ignored is data is specified.
If specified, the amount is distributed evenly across months and funding sources.
Funding sources will be processed in order from first to last.

- **ou_id**: ID of OU this budget is attached to. Required for OU thresholds.

- **project_id**: ID of project this budget is attached to. Required for project budgets.

- **start_datecode** (Required): Year and month the budget starts.



FUNDING REQUIREMENT: Must link funding sources with sufficient funds for the entire time period. Check GET /v3/ou/{id}/funding-source for availability. The system is in allocation mode meaning that the parent ou will need to have appropriate funds allocated to it. Check 'available' and 'allocated_in' fields to check the ou's allocation. If insufficient, ask the user if you can allocate funds from the top level ou's funding sources or if you can create a new funding source.
tool_definitions.name: create_budget

tool_definitions.description:
Creates a funding source in the application.


**Request Body:**

Structure for creating a funding source (Required)


**Request Properties:**

- **amount** (Required): Amount of the funding source.

- **description**: Description for the funding source in the application.

- **end_datecode** (Required): The month this funding source stops being usable - this is exclusive of the date returned (YYYY-MM).

- **name** (Required): Name of the funding source in the application.

- **ou_id**: ID of the top level OU that will receive the funding from this funding source.

- **owner_user_group_ids**: List of groups IDs who will own the funding source. Is required if no owner user IDs are listed.

- **owner_user_ids**: List of user IDs who will own the funding source. Is required if no owner group IDs are listed.

- **permission_scheme_id** (Required): ID of the permission scheme applied to the funding source.

- **start_datecode** (Required): The month this funding source starts being usable (YYYY-MM).

Funding sources can only be created on top level ous. DO NOT!!! create a funding source without explicit user permission on the details. ALWAYS!! ask the user for permission before using this tool.

  • Multiple label values can be AND'd together by providing multiple values to different label_value parameters (for example, label_value=production&label_value=jdoe).

tool_definitions.description:
Get a spend report for the specified date range and filters. This can be dimensioned on many different things like Kion org structures, cloud provider info, and more.
Note that OUs are the primary organizational method in Kion and will likely be your primary filter unless asked for a specific other filter case.
NOTE: If more than 20 dimensions are returned, only the top 19 dimensions by spend will be shown individually, with all remaining dimensions aggregated into an "other" category (e.g., "other services", "other accounts", etc.).
NOTE: This tool is in beta. If there is a non-authentication error with the request or a server error handling the response (or the returns are empty unexpectedly like if 0 spend is unexpected) that means the MCP server is outdated. If you get either of these errors direct the user to update their MCP server, they most likely installed it with either pypi and just need to use pip to update their 'kion-mcp-server' package or via dxt and need to redownload and install the latest dxt. After they complete the update they will need to restart the MCP server most likely by restarting the client you are running in. Direct and help the user through this process.
Always try to use this tool to get the exact number you are passing to the user, only do analysis to derive other numbers if you have access to analysis or code execution tools which you can then use to ensure exact results.
When filtering on something you'll almost certainly NEED an ID for it, look at other tools you can call to get any IDs BEFORE calling this tool. CAREFULLY review your filter options and ensure you're using the correct one with the correct IDs.
IMPORTANT!: UNLESS you are in daily mode (time_granularity_id=2) you MUST ensure the start date is the first of a month and the end date is the first of the excluded end month, otherwise you will get an error. In monthly or by default dates MUST have 01 as their day, e.g., 2023-01-01 to 2023-02-01. DO NOT pass a day other than 01 like 2025-07-31 UNLESS you are in daily mode.
tool_definitions.name: get_spend_report

tool_definitions.description:
Get a spend report for the specified date range and filters. This can be dimensioned on many different things like Kion org structures, cloud provider info, and more.
Note that OUs are the primary organizational method in Kion and will likely be your primary filter unless asked for a specific other filter case.
NOTE: If more than 20 dimensions are returned, only the top 19 dimensions by spend will be shown individually, with all remaining dimensions aggregated into an "other" category (e.g., "other services", "other accounts", etc.).
NOTE: This tool is in beta. If there is a non-authentication error with the request or a server error handling the response (or the returns are empty unexpectedly like if 0 spend is unexpected) that means the MCP server is outdated. If you get either of these errors direct the user to update their MCP server, they most likely installed it with either pypi and just need to use pip to update their 'kion-mcp-server' package or via dxt and need to redownload and install the latest dxt. After they complete the update they will need to restart the MCP server most likely by restarting the client you are running in. Direct and help the user through this process.
Always try to use this tool to get the exact number you are passing to the user, only do analysis to derive other numbers if you have access to analysis or code execution tools which you can then use to ensure exact results.
When filtering on something you'll almost certainly NEED an ID for it, look at other tools you can call to get any IDs BEFORE calling this tool. CAREFULLY review your filter options and ensure you're using the correct one with the correct IDs.
IMPORTANT!: UNLESS you are in daily mode (time_granularity_id=2) you MUST ensure the start date is the first of a month and the end date is the first of the excluded end month, otherwise you will get an error. In monthly or by default dates MUST have 01 as their day, e.g., 2023-01-01 to 2023-02-01. DO NOT pass a day other than 01 like 2025-07-31 UNLESS you are in daily mode.
